comparator: current production Package Adjustment V1.7; for 2v2/2v3/2v4/3v3/3v4/4v4 it fails closed and trade verdict totals remain raw FV sums
deployment_semantics: topology-specific router; a topology uses V9 only if it independently activates; otherwise it remains on V1.7
discordance_definition: opposite V9 vs V1.7 favored sides and each model is outside the frozen 7% fair band
multiplicity_procedure: Holm step-down over six topology-specific one-sided tests
primary_estimand: theta_t = P(manager chooses V9 verdict | V9 and V1.7 give opposite non-fair verdicts, topology t)
theta_min_reason: A 60% win rate on true verdict disagreements is the minimum product-relevant edge chosen before B6 feasibility.
